shots.purpose: V13 opening on the V11 composition: A establish (aircraft upper-middle, figure below), B follow (tilt with the figure), C approach (layered dolly-in)
D reveal: direct cut behind the faller (bare hands), slow push, closed pack circled once
Side tracking; weight arrow draws on from the centre of mass
Purposeful action: forearm lifts, head turns to the wrist; camera pushes toward the wrist
Motivated close-up of the attached device; needle eases down
"Wait, what?": head snaps up from the wrist, blink, arm returns; quick push on the face
Gravity unchanged (arrow re-measured against a tick); air rushes past
Cause and effect: you move down through still air -> camera holds you, air streams up past you -> drag arrow grows
MODEL intro: world freezes, frame draws in; altitude ruler; at rest
Thin-air box beside the body (same box as I1), no force diagram
Weight long, drag short and growing; speed arrow grows; world speeds up
Two equal boxes: thin vs denser air; then same speed under each -> longer drag in denser air
Camera eases in; drag arrow closes on weight; relative airflow
Same air, same posture (fixed box): speed x2 -> drag x4, ghost of the x1 arrow
Arrows grow to equal (balanced: still falling); bars side by side on one scale; drag bar passes weight line; push in; net force up
Lens closes; dashed DOWN still there
One descending trail, a mark every 10 s, one scale: gaps grow then shrink; net UP, moving DOWN
Context; speed arrow shortening; the wrist lifts again
Own forearm (first person), push-in, needle falling
Tilt from the wrist to the approaching ground
Behind: pack still closed (held beat)
Graph builds: axes, zero, rise, top speed, fall that stays above zero
Bars again: drag slightly larger than weight (push in), then still moving down
Pull back; model frame + assumptions line
Graph returns; other inputs drawn on as the narration names them
